title: アオハル杯5戦目にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, it's the day of the Unity Cup finals! We head toward our last challenge as one.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wowzers! We did it! We made it through to the final match!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I c-can't believe it! That means we're up against Team Zenith! That's a big yikes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We work our way up through the tournament until all that remains is to face Team Zenith in the grand final!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've already filled my team in on everything that's been going on with Team Zenith lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With all our preparations complete, we head off to the final match, but on the way there, a loud voice from the grounds catches our attention.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: 1,000 meters in 63.9 seconds! You're going too slow! You're the one who said you were gonna destroy your target time, so run like you mean it!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah! I wonder if she's trying to beat the target time she talked about before?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No way! How could she have improved so much in so little time?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon's face is flushed with exertion as she tries to lower her time with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow… Look at her go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Y-you've got this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We all fall silent as we watch her sprint furiously down the track.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: 1,000 meters left! You've just passed 2 minutes 3.5 seconds! You're on track for a new record, Little Cocon! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon flies down the track with incredible speed. She turns the fourth corner…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And blasts past the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Judging from the triumphant cheers that erupt, I can only assume she's broken her target time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My team is struck speechless for a moment by the display.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Holy moly!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: She really managed to smash her record! And all for Ms. Kashimoto!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-Team Zenith is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon hearing Rice Shower's comment, Taiki Shuttle clenches her fists tightly.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I've… I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We're winning the Unity Cup! I absolutely don't wanna lose today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Team Zenith are mega incredible… But that's exactly why it'll be worth beatin' 'em!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I wanna face 'em head-on and defeat 'em with all our combined strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The whole team's faces light up at Taiki Shuttle's bold declaration.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Yes, I can sense it! I feel a joyful power blossoming between us and Team Zenith!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let's reward our most wonderful rivals with our best performance yet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I just know that happiness is waiting for us at the end of all this!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, races are super fun when you get to run in them with the friends you've been training hard with!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's have fun and win! First place is ours! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I want to win too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Seeing how amazing they are really ignites something in me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A scarce few hours after this rousing call to victory, the final match of the Unity Cup begins!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y'all ready? Happy Hoppers…

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's enough warming up! Time to get a move on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y'all ready? Sunny Runners…

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's enough warming up! Time to get a move on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y'all ready? Carrot Pudding…

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's enough warming up! Time to get a move on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y'all ready? Blue Bloom…

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's enough warming up! Time to get a move on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Y'all ready? Team Carrot…

text_block_list.name: Team Members
text_block_list.text: Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's enough warming up! Time to get a move on!

text_block_list.name: Team Zenith
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: The other team looks pretty fired up. They haven't been slacking either.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yeah, they look loads better than before! You'd all better stay on your toes with them, got it?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: No one knows who's gonna take home the crown today. We've gotta win the medium and long races, Little Cocon!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: I know. We'll win this and finally bring this farce to an end!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I watch over the teams from the stands, I spot a familiar face nearby.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: …Here's to a good race today.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Though I'm not sure if I'm in any position to greet you right now…

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: So you're aware.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I was only so strict because I wanted to protect them… I didn't mean to demoralize them.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I really am an awful trainer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know how much Team Zenith looks up to and admires Ms. Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Why else would they work so hard to beat their target times?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell Ms. Kashimoto what I saw this morning.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon surpassed her target time?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: That's impossible… How could she have done that in such a short period?
choice_data_list: They're giving it everything they've got for your sake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I saw how they reacted when Director Akikawa told us about Ms. Kashimoto's past, and I saw the fire in their eyes this morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It couldn't be clearer how highly Team Zenith regards Ms. Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It may be safe to say that they see her as the best trainer in the world.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: You say that, but…

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I can't trust myself anymore. I learnt nothing from my past, and now my mistakes are playing out all over again…

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it would be best if I cut my ties with Umamusume and the racing world…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto looks down with a weary sigh. I notice there are bags under her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After hearing about her past, I thought it would be impossible to change Ms. Kashimoto's values.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I can help in my own way.
choice_data_list: It's too early to lose faith in yourself yet.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: What are you saying?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although micromanaging Umamusume may keep them safe, it can also stunt their potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the flip side, leaving them wholly to their own devices can lead to terrible accidents with irreversible consequences.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why it's best to be watchful but not overbearing. You should let them be free but always be ready to intervene if they're in danger.
choice_data_list: That's what being a trainer is to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto looks out on the track with a conflicted expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I still don't know if what you say is really the right way to do things…

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: …Let me judge for myself from how these races unfold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow Ms. Kashimoto's gaze to where the members of Team Zenith are diligently doing their warm-ups.
